entries.meaning: （两个或两个以上的人或物中）各自，各个，每个

examples.en: Each student studies English.
examples.zh: 每个同学都学英语。（det.）

examples.en: Each of the students studies English.
examples.zh: 同学们每个人都学英语。（pron.）

examples.en: We each have different interests.
examples.zh: 我们每个人都有不同的兴趣。（同位语）

examples.en: The tickets cost 50 yuan each.
examples.zh: 票价为 50 元每张。（adv.）

examples.en: We should care about each other.
examples.zh: 我们应该互相关心。

examples.en: We need each other's care.
examples.zh: 我们需要彼此的关心。

entries.notes: each 和 every 辨析：① each+单数名词（≥2 人或物，强调个体）；every+单数名词（≥3 人或物，强调整体）——Each student has a new book. / Every girl has a dress. ② every 可与 almost/nearly/not 连用，each 不可——Not every child likes the idea. ③ each 作代词可单独使用、后可接 of；every 只能作限定词，须说 every one of——Each of the students = Every one of the students。另：everyone 只指人、不接 of；every one 可指人/物、可接 of。

phrases.text: plenty of + 不可数名词/可数名词复数

examples.en: We have plenty to talk about.
examples.zh: 我们有说不完的话。

entries.notes: 「大量」短语辨析：plenty of / a lot of / lots of（谓语动词根据 of 后的名词确定）；+不可数名词：a large amount of（谓语用单数）/ large amounts of（谓语用复数）；+可数名词复数：a number of（谓语用复数）。修饰可数：many, few, a few, a number of；修饰不可数：much, little, a little, an amount of；两者皆可：some, a lot of, lots of, plenty of。

phrases.text: make a choice between A and B
phrases.meaning: 在 A 和 B 之间做出选择

phrases.text: have no choice but to do sth.

examples.en: Students need to make a choice between French and German.
examples.zh: 学生们需要在法语和德语之间做出一个选择。

examples.en: He has no choice but to leave.
examples.zh: 除了离开，他别无选择。

examples.en: I have a few friends.
examples.zh: 我有一些朋友。

examples.en: I have few friends.
examples.zh: 我几乎没有朋友。

examples.en: There is a little milk.
examples.zh: 有一点牛奶。

examples.en: There is little milk.
examples.zh: 几乎没有牛奶。

entries.notes: 常用修饰语：just/only/quite a few (a little)；so/too/very few (little)

phrases.meaning: 不客气（回答感谢，做过之后）
乐意效劳（回答请求，做之前）

extensions.meaning: 使满意；使愉快（please sb. 取悦某人）
令人愉快的；宜人的（修饰 sth. = enjoyable）

phrases.meaning: （不）需要做某事（情态动词，need not = needn't）

examples.en: You need to wash this shirt.
examples.zh: 你该洗这件衬衣了。

examples.en: You needn't finish that work today.
examples.zh: 你不必今天做完这项工作。

extensions.meaning: 必需的；必要的（反义词 unnecessary）

phrases.text: It's necessary (for sb.) to do sth.

entries.notes: n. 经济需求 financial needs；It's necessary for me to buy a new one. 我有必要买个新的了。（it 为形式主语）

entries.meaning: 作为；当作；如同；和…一样；照…方式；因为

examples.en: Treat me as a friend.
examples.zh: 像朋友一样对我。（prep. 作为）

examples.en: They did as I had asked.
examples.zh: 他们是按照我的要求做的。（conj. 照…方式）

examples.en: She may need some help as she's new.
examples.zh: 她是新来的，可能需要一些帮助。（conj. 因为）

examples.en: As for English, it's hard to me.
examples.zh: 至于英语，它对我来说很难。

entries.notes: a piece of + 不可数名词；后附讲义「量词小练习」全部量词搭配

entries.meaning: 最后 (= at last = in the end)

phrases.text: boil an egg for sb. / boil sb. an egg

phrases.meaning: 站在某人一边；和某人观点一致

examples.en: There are many trees on either side of the river.
examples.zh: 河的两边都有许多树。（= on both sides / each side）

entries.meaning: 搅拌，打；赢，打败（某人）；胜过；规律作响 (beat-beaten-beating)

phrases.meaning: 把 A 和 B 搅拌在一起

examples.en: He beat me at chess.
examples.zh: 他下棋赢了我。

examples.en: Her heart is still beating.
examples.zh: 她的心脏还在跳动。

entries.notes: 四个义项：①（用叉等）快速搅拌、打；②（比赛或竞争中）赢、打败某人；③比…更好、赛过、胜过；④（使）规律作响、作节奏运动

examples.en: What's on the menu tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚有什么菜？

examples.en: He wants to cook something healthy for his mother on her birthday.
examples.zh: 他想在母亲生日那天为她做点健康的食物。

examples.en: We can use the metal of the car to make something else.
examples.zh: 我们可以用汽车的金属来制造别的东西。

examples.en: Something is bothering you, isn't it?
examples.zh: 某些事情困扰着你，不是吗？

examples.en: My family means everything to me.
examples.zh: 对我来说家庭意味着一切。

examples.en: He realized right away that there was something wrong.
examples.zh: 他马上意识到有地方不对劲。

examples.en: Was there anything else you wanted to say?
examples.zh: 你还有什么要说的吗？

examples.en: I consider nothing is more important than happiness in my life.
examples.zh: 我认为我的生活中没有什么比快乐更重要。

examples.en: Have you seen anything unusual today?
examples.zh: 你今天看到什么不寻常的事了吗？

extensions.meaning: 每件事；一切事（肯定/疑问/否定句均可用）
某事；任何事（一般用于否定句或疑问句）

entries.notes: ① something 作主语时，反义疑问句用 it。② everything/something/anything/nothing 作主语时，谓语动词用单数。③ something 常用于肯定句，也可用于征求对方意见的疑问句。④ 复合不定代词+adj.（anything unusual）；复合不定代词+to do——I'm worried that there isn't anybody to take care of the children while we are away. ⑤ 其他复合不定代词：somebody/someone、anybody/anyone、everybody/everyone、nobody/no one

examples.en: Add a little salt to the sauce.
examples.zh: 往酱汁里加点儿盐。

examples.en: This product contains no animal fat.
examples.zh: 这种产品不含有动物油脂。

examples.en: We are all products of our time.
examples.zh: 我们都是时代的产物。

examples.en: The factory produced a large amount of modern furniture.
examples.zh: 这家工厂生产了大量的现代家具。

examples.en: The new model will go into production next year.
examples.zh: 新车型将于明年投入生产。

examples.en: It is essential that your diet is varied and balanced.
examples.zh: 重要的是你的饮食应当是多样而平衡的。

examples.en: Nature is perfectly balanced.
examples.zh: 大自然是完美平衡的。

examples.en: Larry has put on too much weight because of an unbalanced diet.
examples.zh: Larry 因为饮食不均衡，体重增加了太多。

examples.en: Try to keep a balance between work and play.
examples.zh: 要努力在工作和玩中间保持平衡。

examples.en: Diets vary from country to country.
examples.zh: 世界各国的饮食各不相同。

examples.en: The doctor told Tom to give up smoking and be on a diet.
examples.zh: 医生告诉汤姆要戒烟节食。
